title: How to Sort Your Kabadi for Best Prices
titleNp: कबाडी छुट्याउने उत्तम तरिका, धेरै मूल्य पाउनुहोस्
author: Rahul Bhai
excerpt: Learn the best ways to sort your recyclable items like paper, plastic, and metals to get the highest payout from our collectors.
excerptNp: कागज, प्लास्टिक र धातुहरू कसरी सही तरिकाले छुट्याउने र धेरै पैसा कमाउने भनेर सिक्नुहोस्।
content:
Why Sorting Matters

Sorting your scrap materials before the collector arrives not only saves time but also guarantees you get the maximum value for each item. Mixed scrap is often evaluated at the lowest common price, so separating your goods is essential.

1. Paper and Cardboard

Keep your newspapers, notebooks, and cardboard boxes dry and tied in separate bundles. Wet paper loses its value significantly.

2. Plastics

Separate PET bottles (water bottles) from hard plastics (buckets, chairs). Rinse out any food or liquid residue.

3. Metals

Metals offer the highest returns. Use a magnet to easily separate iron (magnetic) from aluminum and copper (non-magnetic). Copper wiring should be stripped if possible, though we accept unstripped wires at a different rate.
contentNp:
छुट्याउनु किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ

कबाडी सङ्कलनकर्ता आउनु अघि तपाईंका सामानहरू छुट्याउँदा समय मात्र बचत हुँदैन, यसले प्रत्येक वस्तुको अधिकतम मूल्य पाउन पनि मद्दत गर्छ।

१. कागज र गत्ता

पत्रपत्रिका, कापी र गत्ताका बाकसहरू सुक्खा राख्नुहोस् र छुट्टै बन्डलमा बाँध्नुहोस्।

२. प्लास्टिक

पीईटी बोतलहरू (पानीका बोतलहरू) लाई कडा प्लास्टिक (बाल्टी, कुर्सी) बाट अलग राख्नुहोस्।

३. धातुहरू

धातुहरूबाट धेरै पैसा पाइन्छ। फलामलाई आल्मुनियम र तामाबाट सजिलै छुट्याउन चुम्बक प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।

title: Nepal Recycling Industry Growing Fast in 2026
titleNp: सन् २०२६ मा नेपालको रिसाइक्लिङ उद्योग द्रुत गतिमा बढ्दै
author: KabadiBhaiya Team
excerpt: The recycling industry in Nepal has seen a massive 40% growth this year, creating green jobs and cleaner cities.
excerptNp: यस वर्ष नेपालमा रिसाइक्लिङ उद्योगमा ४०% वृद्धि भएको छ, जसले हरियो रोजगारी र सफा शहर निर्माण गरिरहेको छ।
content:
A Greener Economy

In 2026, Nepal's recycling sector has experienced unprecedented growth. With increased awareness and better digital platforms like KabadiBhaiya, more households than ever are participating in the circular economy.

We are seeing new processing plants open in the Kathmandu Valley, capable of handling higher volumes of plastics and electronic waste (e-waste). This not only keeps our rivers and streets cleaner but also reduces our reliance on imported raw materials.

The Future

The government is also drafting new policies to support informal waste workers and integrate them into the formal sector, providing better safety gear, stable incomes, and social security.
contentNp:
हरियो अर्थतन्त्र

सन् २०२६ मा नेपालको रिसाइक्लिङ क्षेत्रले अभूतपूर्व वृद्धि हासिल गरेको छ। कबाडीभैया जस्ता राम्रा डिजिटल प्लेटफर्महरूको कारण धेरै घरधुरीहरू यसमा सहभागी भइरहेका छन्।

हामीले काठमाडौं उपत्यकामा नयाँ प्रशोधन प्लान्टहरू खुलेको देखेका छौं।

title: Complete Guide: Kabadi Items and Their Worth
titleNp: पूर्ण गाइड: कबाडीका सामानहरू र तिनको मूल्य
author: Pramila Gurung
excerpt: Not sure what to sell? Here is a comprehensive guide to common household scrap items and their estimated market value.
excerptNp: के बेच्ने निश्चित हुनुहुन्न? यहाँ सामान्य घरायसी कबाडी सामानहरू र तिनको अनुमानित बजार मूल्यको गाइड छ।
content:
Know Your Scrap

Many households throw away items that have significant value. Here is a breakdown of what you should be saving.

Electronic Waste (E-waste)

Old smartphones, broken laptops, and tangled chargers are highly valuable because they contain precious metals like gold, silver, and copper. Never throw these in the regular trash; they can leak harmful chemicals.

Metals

Brass (Pital) and Copper (Tamba) are the kings of the scrap world. Even small amounts can fetch hundreds of Rupees. Iron (Falam) and Aluminum (Almunium) are cheaper but accumulate quickly.

Paper

Old school books, copies, and newspapers are bought by the kilo. We send them to paper mills where they are pulped and turned into new recycled paper products.
contentNp:
आफ्नो कबाडी चिन्नुहोस्

धेरै घरहरूले मूल्यवान वस्तुहरू फ्याँकिरहेका हुन्छन्।

विद्युतीय फोहोर (ई-वेस्ट)

पुराना फोन, बिग्रिएका ल्यापटप र चार्जरहरू धेरै मूल्यवान हुन्छन् किनभने तिनमा सुन, चाँदी जस्ता धातुहरू हुन्छन्।

title: How KabadiBhaiya is Helping Keep Kathmandu Clean
titleNp: कबाडीभैयाले काठमाडौंलाई कसरी सफा राख्न मद्दत गरिरहेको छ
author: KabadiBhaiya Team
excerpt: Discover how our digital pickup service is reducing landfill waste and transforming the waste management landscape in the capital.
excerptNp: हाम्रो डिजिटल पिकअप सेवाले कसरी फोहोर घटाउँदैछ र राजधानीको फोहोर व्यवस्थापनलाई परिवर्तन गर्दैछ भनेर जान्नुहोस्।
content:
The Trash Problem

Kathmandu has struggled with waste management for decades. Landfills are overflowing, and recyclable materials often end up polluting the Bagmati river.

Our Solution

By making recycling easy and profitable for households, KabadiBhaiya has diverted over 500 tons of recyclable waste from landfills in the past year alone. Our on-demand pickup model means no more waiting for the local kabadiwala to pass by your street. You schedule, we pick up, you get paid, and the city gets cleaner.
contentNp:
फोहोरको समस्या

काठमाडौंले दशकौंदेखि फोहोर व्यवस्थापनसँग संघर्ष गरिरहेको छ। ल्यान्डफिलहरू भरिएका छन्।

हाम्रो समाधान

रिसाइक्लिङलाई सजिलो बनाएर, कबाडीभैयाले गत वर्ष मात्र ५०० टन भन्दा बढी फोहोर ल्यान्डफिलबाट जोगाएको छ।

title: eSewa and Khalti: Getting Paid Instantly for Your Scrap
titleNp: ईसेवा र खल्ती: तपाईंको कबाडीको तुरुन्तै भुक्तानी पाउनुहोस्
author: Rahul Bhai
excerpt: No change? No problem! Learn how to receive your scrap payouts directly into your digital wallets like eSewa and Khalti.
excerptNp: खुद्रा पैसा छैन? समस्या छैन! ईसेवा र खल्ती जस्ता डिजिटल वालेटहरूमा सीधै कसरी भुक्तानी लिने सिक्नुहोस्।
content:
Going Cashless

Finding exact change is a common problem in the scrap business. To solve this, KabadiBhaiya fully integrates with Nepal's leading digital wallets: eSewa, Khalti, and IME Pay.

When our collector weighs your items and calculates the total, you can simply show your wallet QR code, or provide your registered mobile number. The transfer happens instantly before the collector leaves your premises. It's safe, contactless, and incredibly convenient.
contentNp:
नगदरहित हुँदै

कबाडी व्यवसायमा खुद्रा पैसा पाउनु सामान्य समस्या हो। यसको समाधान गर्न, कबाडीभैयाले ईसेवा, खल्ती र आईएमई पेसँग सहकार्य गरेको छ।

सङ्कलनकर्ताले तौल गरेपछि, तपाईंले आफ्नो वालेटको क्यूआर कोड देखाउन वा मोबाइल नम्बर दिन सक्नुहुन्छ। भुक्तानी तुरुन्तै हुन्छ।

title: Bhaktapur and Lalitpur Now Covered: Our Expansion
titleNp: भक्तपुर र ललितपुर अब कभर: हाम्रो विस्तार
author: KabadiBhaiya Team
excerpt: Great news! KabadiBhaiya's doorstep pickup services are now officially available across all major areas of Bhaktapur and Lalitpur.
excerptNp: खुसीको खबर! कबाडीभैयाको घरदैलो पिकअप सेवा अब भक्तपुर र ललितपुरका सबै प्रमुख क्षेत्रहरूमा उपलब्ध छ।
content:
Growing the Network

After a successful launch and operation in Kathmandu, we are thrilled to announce that KabadiBhaiya has expanded its fleet to cover Lalitpur (Patan) and Bhaktapur.

Residents in these historic cities can now schedule pickups via our website or WhatsApp. We have hired and trained 20 new local collectors in these regions to ensure fast and reliable service. Join the recycling movement today!
contentNp:
नेटवर्क विस्तार

काठमाडौंमा सफल सञ्चालन पछि, हामी ललितपुर र भक्तपुरमा सेवा विस्तार गर्न पाउँदा खुसी छौं।

अब यी शहरका बासिन्दाहरूले हाम्रो वेबसाइट वा ह्वाट्सएप मार्फत पिकअप तालिका बनाउन सक्छन्। हामीले २० नयाँ स्थानीय सङ्कलनकर्ताहरूलाई तालिम दिएका छौं।
